newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLO euphoria could be shortlived.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLO euphoria could be shortlived.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds soared to a sharply higher close on Friday but traders warned the euphoria could be shortlived.
Softer than expected U.S. inflation data wiped out fears of a U.S. rate hike and propelled Bunds and OLOs to higher regions.
The 10-year OLO/Bund yield spread narrowed to 19 from 22 basis points, further raising traders' fears that OLOs had become too expensive.
One noted however 10-year OLOs were outperforming the market. "It's supported by a major foreign buyer who is not buying aggressively. But it doesn't look like it's over."
One trader said that the market was well-supported but that prices would be undermined by some profit-taking early next week.
Another said he was convinced the OLO yield curve would not steepen any further.
"Short-term rates will remain at these levels," he said. "This is the steepest we can get, if you ask me."
He said that the market would next look at German wholesale prices early next week.
